name: duopore-public-property-enquiry-actions
description: Turn property enquiry questions into a clear list of replies and follow-up dates.

interface.longDescription: Turn property enquiry questions into a clear list of replies and follow-up dates. Share questions, requested actions and due dates using reference codes. See what needs a reply and what is overdue. Leave out personal contact details. This is a planning list; the app does not screen applicants, decide housing access, send replies or contact people.
defaultPrompt: Organize these property questions into follow-up actions.
Which property enquiry actions are overdue?
